patterns.note: Hero section features extremely oversized, layered text that dominates the initial viewport, with project previews appearing below.
Content sections frequently use a dark background with high-contrast white typography, creating a dramatic visual impact.
Headings are set in a wide, geometric sans-serif, often in all caps and at an immense scale, serving as primary visual elements rather than just text.
Large text elements (e.g., 'MILL3', 'CRAFTED INNOVATION') animate into view with a subtle slide-up and fade, or parallax effect, creating a sense of depth and dynamism as the user scrolls.
The primary palette is stark black and white, with vibrant, project-specific accent colors introduced within individual case studies.
A prominent, full-width footer with the brand name in a bold, bright accent color, mirroring the hero's oversized typography.

technique_notes: The site employs a smooth scrolling library (likely locomotive-scroll) to enhance the user experience and enable precise scroll-triggered animations.
Scroll-triggered reveals are used for major content blocks and large text headings, making elements slide up and fade in as they enter the viewport.
The hero section features a large, layered text element that appears to parallax, moving at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a sense of depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very oversized, wide, uppercase sans-serif headings (~4-6x body text) with a clean, modern sans-serif for body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (predominantly sharp corners on elements and images).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between major sections, creating distinct visual blocks; balanced horizontal spacing within content areas).

standout: The site's distinctive use of massive, animated typography as a primary visual element, often layered or partially obscured, creates a bold and dynamic aesthetic that feels more like an interactive art piece than a typical agency portfolio. The high-contrast black and white base, punctuated by vibrant project-specific palettes, further enhances this dramatic effect.
